notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
Both 0.2.9 write-path agents had to duplicate private xref.rs helpers because xref.rs was
owned by a concurrent agent:
  write.rs::find_current_startxref  <- xref.rs private read_start_xref (pdf-xref.c:1010)
  annot_edit.rs::locate_page        <- half of xref.rs private walk_pages

Matters more than usual: this is CROSS-REFERENCE parsing. Two copies = a bug fixed in one
silently persists in the other, and this crate has already been bitten by that class
(gh-70 objstm cache poisoning, shipped in 0.2.8).

locate_page has a sharper cause and is really an API GAP, not just duplication:
PdfDocument::page() returns an inheritance-FLATTENED page dict with no indirect-reference
identity, so a caller that needs to WRITE BACK to a page cannot learn its object number
from the public API at all. Anything editing a page hits this.

FIX: (1) read_start_xref -> pub(crate), write.rs calls it. (2) add
PdfDocument::page_ref(index) -> Option<i32> (or keep identity in page()), then locate_page
goes away. (3) delete both duplicates; tests/authoring.rs is the strongest gate since it
round-trips through poppler.

Neither duplicate is wrong today -- both faithful and tested. This is about not carrying
two copies of xref logic for a decade.

title: kopitiam-pdf: write path duplicates private xref helpers; no public page object number
